parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the cooling of water. The apparatus shown in Fig. 3.1 has been assembled for you. Fig. 3.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Measure and record the room temperature θ R to the nearest 0.5 °C. θ R = ......................................................°C [1]

parts.label: i
parts.text: (b) (i) • Pour approximately 60 cm 3 of hot water into the beaker. • Wait for 30 s. • Measure and record in Table 3.1, the temperature θ of the water at time t = 0. • Immediately start the stop-watch and measure the temperature of the water at one-minute intervals for 5 minutes. Record in Table 3.1 the temperatures to the nearest 1 °C. Table 3.1 time t / min temperature θ / °C 0 1 2 3 4 5 [2]

parts.label: i
parts.text: (c) (i) Calculate the decrease in temperature Δθ of the hot water during the first two minutes of cooling. Δθ = ......................................................°C [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the average rate of cooling R 1 of the hot water during the first two minutes of cooling. Use the equation: R 1 = decrease in temperature time R 1 = .............................................. °C / min [1]

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Calculate the average rate of cooling R 2 of the hot water during the final two minutes of cooling. R 2 = .............................................. °C / min [1]

parts.text: (e) The water in the beaker is left to continue cooling.
